reuse.why: Extends the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend and firstWeekdayOccurrence helpers with an optional holidays argument and every caller keeps using them.

duplication.why: Weekend-or-holiday is defined once in isNonWorkingDay and the two copied adjustment ternaries in schedule-template are folded into one closure; only the 'extra search budget = holidays.length' padding is repeated in three places.

placement.why: The day rule lives in shared/schedules.ts beside the existing weekend helpers; server code only forwards the config field.

scope.why: Touches only the weekend-handling paths, the RecurConfig type, rule parsing of the field, a focused test and a release note.

maintainability.why: A single predicate plus a generic step loop is easy to extend, though each caller must remember to thread config.holidays and adjust its own search bounds.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All weekend-skip sites (getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange, schedule-template) go through isNonWorkingDay/getDateWithSkippedWeekend.

disguised_duplication.where: Only the small holidays-length padding is repeated, openly, in firstWeekdayOccurrence, getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange.

one_place.where: isNonWorkingDay in shared/schedules.ts, used by getDateWithSkippedWeekend, firstWeekdayOccurrence and the daily-skip checks in schedules/app.ts.
